purpose: coordinate-truth controlled spike-in cases derived from verified source sequences

coordinate_convention.identity: substitution identity before optional indel events
coordinate_convention.coverage: union of source query coordinates, not sum of fragment lengths

source_requirements: catalog records must be checksum verified
background files must be checksum verified and explicitly declared as real assembly backgrounds
controlled derivatives carry the source background identifier and checksum
duplicated source backgrounds are not independent metagenomes
source annotations are required before shared mobile-element, chromosome-shared, or repeat-rich labels are emitted
